propositions: The voter-errors alarm currently fires on any single marker in a 5-minute window (1x300s, Sum>0), causing page storms from transient self-healing errors that do not require operator intervention.

Transient voter errors clear within one evaluation period or when boundary-straddling occur in two consecutive periods; sustained failures (expired token, LLM outage, Gerrit down) produce markers across consecutive 5-minute intervals due to continuous webhook queue and backfill reconciler retries.

The alarm must be recalibrated from single-period to 3-of-5 datapoints shape (evaluation_periods=5, datapoints_to_alarm=3, threshold=0, Sum>0) to suppress isolated transients while detecting sustained failures within ~15 minutes.

The Terraform change applies only through manual operator execution per provision-restore.md plan-before-apply workflow; landing via Gerrit does not apply to AWS, and the daily terraform-drift sweep will flag the pending change until applied.
